label: Comparative Analysis
description: Compare options, systems, plans, models, vendors, or tradeoffs.

classifier.useWhen: User asks which option is better and why.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to execute a direct edit.

label: Evaluation
description: Score or assess quality, fit, risk, or performance against criteria.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for an evaluation rubric or assessment.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for pure creative brainstorming.

label: Prioritization
description: Rank work, risks, options, or next steps.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what to do first or how to sequence work.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to write code immediately.

label: Metrics Definition
description: Define metrics, KPIs, dimensions, and measurement logic.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what to measure or how to evaluate.

label: Risk Assessment
description: Identify, score, and compare risks across options or plans.

classifier.useWhen: User asks what risks matter and how severe they are.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for security exploit details only.

label: Analytical Root Cause
description: Analyze non-code causes behind outcomes, incidents, or business symptoms.

classifier.useWhen: User asks why a metric, process, or outcome changed.

label: Analysis Report
description: Produce a structured analytical report with findings and recommendations.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for an analysis write-up.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for a short creative slogan.

label: Data Interpretation
description: Interpret charts, tables, metrics, or experiment results.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to transform raw data formats only.

label: Decision Matrix
description: Create a weighted decision matrix or scoring rubric.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to choose among options with criteria.

label: Trend Analysis
description: Analyze trends, changes, seasonality, or directional movement.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how something is changing over time.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for current facts only.
